auxiliary_material: 研究讨论了 FMT 在 ICI 耐药背景下的挑战，包括供体选择（本研究使用 ICI 响应者作为供体）、给药途径（结肠镜联合灌肠）及患者选择（快速进展患者可能无法从 FMT 获益）。文中提及了其他早期单臂研究（如 Baruch et al., Davar et al.）的阳性结果作为对比，并引用了另一项随机试验（TACITO 试验）的近期发表结果作为未来研究方向，但未提供该随机试验的具体数据。研究强调了当前证据主要集中在早期阶段，且存在异质性。

Mechanistic analyses included shotgun metagenomic sequencing showing separate clustering of responders and non-responders post-FMT, with enrichment of Prevotella copri, Ruminoccocaceae, and Eubacterium in responders. Translational validation was performed using avatar mice, where feces from responder patients conferred reduced tumor growth and improved control with dual ICI compared to non-responder feces. Additionally, higher plasma sST2 levels one week after FMT were associated with the development of colitis. Median follow-up was 6 months.
note: The gap judgment and ready writing material are reported separately.
outline_action: Retry after the provider or judgment issue is resolved; do not treat this attempt as scientific absence.

query_audits.query_text: ongoing phase III randomized controlled trial fecal microbiota transplantation immune checkpoint inhibitor solid tumor

Are there any currently ongoing or recently completed large-scale phase III randomized controlled trials evaluating the efficacy of fecal microbiota transplantation in patients with solid tumors treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors?

remaining_gap: 是否存在已完成的、大规模随机对照 III 期试验证实微生物组干预在 ICI 治疗患者中的疗效？
useful_material: 本研究（MITRIC 试验，NCT05286294）是一项单臂、IIa 期篮子试验，纳入 12 名对免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）耐药的晚期癌症患者（主要为黑色素瘤，另有头颈鳞癌、肾细胞癌、胰腺癌各 1 例）。研究评估了来自 ICI 长期响应者的粪便微生物移植（FMT）联合 ICI 治疗的安全性和有效性。主要结果显示客观缓解率（ORR）为 0%（0/12），中位无进展生存期（PFS）为 1.5 个月，中位总生存期（OS）为 10.1 个月。仅 1 例黑色素瘤患者达到方案定义的临床获益（稳定疾病>6 个月）。安全性方面，FMT 耐受性良好，50% 患者发生免疫相关不良事件（irAEs），多为 1-2 级。研究还通过质谱流式细胞术分析了外周血免疫细胞，发现基线高分化 T 细胞特征与较好预后相关，而髓系优势环境与不良预后相关，且 FMT 未显著改变外周血免疫景观。

This study reports results from a Phase II trial (FMT-LUMINate, NCT04951583) involving 20 previously untreated patients with advanced melanoma receiving fecal microbiota transplantation (FMT) combined with dual immune checkpoint inhibitors (ipilimumab and nivolumab). The design was single-arm with safety as the primary endpoint. The authors observed an objective response rate (ORR) of 70% (2 complete responses, 12 partial responses), but also noted high rates of immune-related adverse events (65% grade >3, including 20% diarrhea/colitis and 2 cases of myocarditis). The conclusion states that these results support the study of FMT and immunotherapy in the randomized setting, indicating that definitive randomized evidence is not yet established by this work.
